text_block_list.text:
Late last year, Wonder Acute finally ran 
alongside none other than Smart Falcon in 
the Tokyo Daishoten.

Just how deeply did that steady, quiet 
effort resonate with those striving for a 
comeback?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone.

At the boxing gym run by Wonder Acute's 
father. When I joined the students on 
their roadwork...

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
Ah, young lady! Well if it isn't the young 
lady!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Aw, stop calling me 'young lady.' It 
feels weird when you use such fancy 
words~."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't be more embarrassed, oh gosh. 
No, no... No, no, no...

Wonder Acute got embarrassed and tried to 
walk away, so I hastily held her back.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Sooo, everyone. You all watched that Tokyo 
Daishoten, right?

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text: Of course! We all watched it together!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: So, how did it go?

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course I was thrilled! To think 
I'd get to run in such a huge race!

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text: Splendid, young lady!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I see, I see. So that's what you thought.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I feel like you've given me a bit of 
hope!

With those words, the trainee returned to 
her training in high spirits—

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! If we just take it one steady 
step at a time—"

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainee
text_block_list.text:
We might even make it far enough to 
witness the champion's glory. Let's show 
some grit.

text_block_list.name: Boxing Trainees
text_block_list.text: Got it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Worship... the brilliance? Worship, huh...

Wonder Acute had a slightly bewildered 
look on her face. And then—

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course I was watching. Why, it was 
truly, truly, magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Grandma
text_block_list.text:
I'm just really glad I could run. That's 
all there is to it, really.

The elderly folks had a similar reaction. 
They were all delighted by Wonder Acute's 
success.
Still—that's all it is.

Wonder Acute sat lost in thought for a 
long while, as if meditating. And then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer, since when, I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Kin-san... has turned into Gin-san, hasn't 
she?

I couldn't understand what she was saying. 
Wonder Acute let out a gentle sigh, and 
then—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
When I was little, I loved historical 
dramas, ye see...

text_block_list.name: Young Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's Kin-san! I am Kin-san! Bow your heads 
before me, everyone~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I used to pretend to be the hero in period 
dramas all the time. Standing coolly right 
in the middle of all the other 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've ended up with the personality of an 
old veteran, y'see. Just happy if I can 
warmly support someone along the way.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Is this what it means to become an adult? 
Or is it...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Maybe they're trying too hard to be 
sensible... Suppressing their natural 
instincts.

Within those words, I sensed a sheer force 
of spirit unlike anything I had ever felt 
before.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, there's a beast... inside me too, 
ya know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Especially when cutting weight and my mind 
gets hazy... I feel it. That beast.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Still, she holds it back deep down, 
trying not to rush through life..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I try not to rush, but deep down in my 
heart... I feel it strongly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I want to sprint right away. I want to win 
right away. Once I take the lead, I don't 
want to give it up to anyone...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"And an Umamusume who can run straight and 
true, without hiding those feelings, is—"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
――She becomes an "aspiration," doesn't 
she? Not just someone who is strong.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know the saying, right? 'Right in 
theory, poor in reality.' My running is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"At first glance, it's solid, but it lacks 
the single most important thing to make 
people dream: 'charizzma'..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That might be fine if you just want a long 
career, but if I want everyone to feel, 'I 
want to shine once more,' then...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just catching up to Falco-san might not be 
enough, don't you think?

Just managing to catch up won't move 
anyone's heart. Yes, what I must do is—

"Making her strongly desire a 'comeback.' 
To become the protagonist of her own 
story. To achieve that..."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I sure want to win... outshining Falco-san 
with my radiance.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I want to win, Trainer. I really do.

"Yes, Wonder Acute possesses the 
formidable weapon of tenacity."

I just have to keep running in the Twinkle 
Series for a long time. If I keep building 
it up like that, then someday...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's true... If you want to win while 
taking each season at an easy pace, maybe 
it's better not to rush.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But I wanna win right here, right now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Giving dreams to those who don't have long 
left to live. No, it's not just that...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Me... Little old me... I'm just itching to 
win right this second, you see.

It's not just goodwill. On top of that, 
it's likely—instinct.

Wonder Acute wants to take center stage. 
By running faster than anyone else.
choice_data_list: Still, as for your next race...

text_block_list.text:
We're running out of time. The gap in pure 
strength between us and Smart Falcon is 
still far too wide.

To bring her to a level where she can 
reliably compete, our current training 
plan is...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I really don't think silver can match 
gold, you know. Not in equal amounts, 
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what if? What if we could somehow 
gather that radiance in an instant... 
instead of taking so many long years?"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Layering the longing of a thousand 
autumns... without waiting. If the art of 
living a long, skilled life is what we 
call "wisdom"...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Daring to discard that wisdom and rush 
ahead is, I believe, a kind of wisdom in 
itself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. Even if it cuts my time 
short, even if I'm rushing to the end.

I understood what she was getting at. 
Taking her greatest strengths—her stamina 
and perseverance—

Throwing everything away for an "all-out 
adjustment." Doing that at the Kawasaki 
Kinen—?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My mind is made up. After hearing what 
everyone had to say, I understand 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san knows my running best, though. 
What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If I push myself beyond all limits... will 
I reach it?

—She questions me with an earnest gaze. 
Indeed, I know Wonder Acute's potential 
inside and out.

I'm no longer the clouded person I was 
before. If I push myself from here on out—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohoho, really?
choice_data_list: But the recoil might be huge, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I don't mind. Why would I care?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A splint's true happiness, you see... is 
to support, above all else.

What looked like an old tree... was 
unimaginably supple and strong. And then—
(Dadadadada!!)

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... These shrine 
stairs... are so long... and steep...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And... 10 more...? I see, you need that 
many, huh. In that case...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
—Guess I have no choice. Yes, I'll see it 
through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have nothing left to regret. If that is 
so—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Ah... If I don't worry about the 
consequences, I can do this much...! It's 
nice to just let loose every once in a 
while.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Horyaaaaaaaah!!!!!!

"Piling up immense amounts of training. 
Yes, this is—borrowing from the future."

"Hastily gathering up the time that was 
supposed to be spent in long, joyful 
leisure."
The silver was polished, until eventually—

It began to radiate an unprecedented, 
mature brilliance.
